task: Stack green block on red block and release both grippers
account: Existing is5090 Codex login; no account changes
decision_inputs: Previous RGB from this episode only
Own episode decisions, memory and sanitized motion receipts
prohibited_inputs: Prior experiments or successful action sequences
Host skills, memories, rules or tools

isolation.filesystem: bubblewrap private mount/user/PID/IPC/UTS namespaces; no project/user directory mounts
isolation.model_sessions: New ephemeral invocation per decision; no resume; only this episode memory supplied
isolation.tools: Execution/search/MCP/plugins/skills/memories disabled; non-text model events fail closed
isolation.filesystem_audit: strace file syscalls per call, with input hashes
isolation.network: Provider transport uses host network; no model tools enabled; bridge credential is outside namespace
isolation.preflight: Passed filesystem + scene-free inference + unknown-tool rejection tests
isolation.startup_diagnostic: Exact pre-turn code-mode-disabled message permitted; no other error/tool item permitted

scene_selection: Cryptographic random seed excluded from training and recorded earlier runs; sampled once, no solvability filtering
controller: Model chooses world TCP poses/translations/gripper targets; generic motion planner executes them
success: Official task success and all 500 additional physics-step checks successful
terminal_failure: Block fell below floor threshold or official success failed stability verification
infrastructure_failure: Pause and report separately; do not count as task failure or silently change policy
recording: All action physics at 25 fps / 10 physics steps per frame; paused inference time omitted
limitations: Generic controller was developed before this run; independent model receives no expert solution, prior dialogue or earlier actions
One episode does not estimate robust task success rate
